comment_regular: Verified owner-resolution order: return this reference's direct XOWN; for non-actors only, try a linked door's XOWN; if still absent, inherit the parent cell's direct owner except for furniture, doors, and activators. Actors never inherit linked-door/cell ownership. Fallout's analogous GetOwner includes an encounter-zone-owner fallback before parent-cell handling; Oblivion's body has no such branch.
